question.text:
Arrange the following functions by their asymptotic growth rate in increasing order.

  • $f_1(n)=(\log n)^{\log n}$
     
  • $f_2(n)=2^{\sqrt{\log _2 n}}$
     
  • $f_3(n)=n^{1 / 3}(\log n)^3$
     
  • $f_4(n)=(\sqrt{2})^{\log _2 n}$
     
  1. $f_2, f_3, f_4, f_1$
     
  2. $f_2, f_4, f_3, f_1$
     
  3. $f_3, f_2, f_1, f_4$
     
  4. $f_2, f_3, f_1, f_4$

question.text:
Consider the following three statements regarding asymptotic notation:

I. $\log \left(n^c\right)=\Theta(\log n)$ where $c>0$ is a constant

II. $3^{n+5}=\Theta\left(3^n\right)$

III. $3^{2 n}=O\left(3^n\right)$

Which of the above statements are correct?

  1. I and II
     
  2. I and III
     
  3. II and III
     
  4. I, II, and III
